notes.title: The Challenge Update - Now Available!
notes.content:
[p]Hello Squires!  We're landing a huge game update packed with new features that will completely change your experience with The Plucky Squire!  [/p][p][/p][p]This update introduces two new game modes—[b]Challenge Mode and Iron Squire Mode[/b]—along with new enemies, enemy variants, and minigame updates. So if you’ve think it was too easy, The Challenge Update might just change your mind.[/p][p][/p][p]Plus, we’re offering our [b]biggest discount yet[/b] during the Steam Summer Sale![/p][p][/p][previewyoutube="T1K38O_msm8;full"][/previewyoutube][p][/p][p]Here’s the full list of new features and changes that you’ll find in [b]The Challenge Update[/b]:  [/p][p][/p][h3]New Challenge Mode[/h3][p]Challenge Mode is a new game mode designed to test your skills with increased difficulty. This mode includes:[/p][list][*][p] New enemies [/p][/*][*][p] Harder minigames[/p][/*][*][p] Harder bosses [/p][/*][*][p] Some layout changes for levels [/p][/*][*][p] The ability to fast forward through dialogue and [/p][/*][*][p] New Achievements
[/p][/*][/list][h3]Remixed Pages[/h3][p]Pages with combat on have been reworked and side scrolling levels have new layouts.  [/p][p][/p][h3]Humgrump Desk Spawns[/h3][p]In the previous version of the game, we had Humgrump teleport some enemies into the level using his metamagic, but only in the book. We've now added these sequences to the desk too. These spawn in with VFX and a bubble that contains Humgrump's face. Additionally, Jot can get electrified on the desk.  [/p][p][/p][h3]New Metamagic Enemies[/h3][p]Following on from the above, we have the glowing metamagic variants of some of the base enemies. They have their own effects and materials on the desk, and new sprites in the book.[/p][list][*][p] Barfer Bug[/p][/*][*][p] Rat[/p][/*][*][p] Goblin[/p][/*][*][p] Spear Trooper[/p][/*][*][p] Popuff
[/p][/*][/list][h3]Challenge Mode Enemy Variants[/h3][p]We have some upgraded versions of the existing enemies. These are all across both desk and book.[/p][list][*][p] Tough Goblin (just harder)[/p][/*][*][p] Exploding Goblins (run at you and explode)[/p][/*][*][p] Metal Goblins (indestructible)[/p][/*][*][p] Exploding Jumper bugs[/p][/*][*][p] Tough Namastarlings (just harder)[/p][/*][*][p] There's a new tough book-only enemy, the Rock Golem, which appears from Chapter 2.
[/p][/*][/list][h3]More Difficult Minigame Patterns[/h3][p]All of the minigames, apart from the Sneak C09 game, Fish Grabbing and the C04 Fantasy Card Game have new difficulty settings and layouts. Buttergrump also has new patterns. There are little bits of extra functionality in some of these games as a result, such as ghost Archery bugs and new projectiles in Buttergrump.  [/p][p][/p][h3]New Iron Squire Mode[/h3][p]The Plucky Squire with permadeath! This is essentially Challenge Mode but with no continues. As soon as you die in Iron Squire Mode, your save is deleted, and you are sent to a new game over screen. We have one each for desk and the book.  [/p][p][/p][h3]Four New Achievements[/h3][p]There have been five Challenge Mode-specific achievements added.[/p][list][*][p]Complete Challenge Mode: Pops up at the same point that the Adventure/Story Mode one pops up. It also auto-completes the Adventure/Story Mode too.[/p][/*][*][p]Get to Artia in Iron Squire Mode: This triggers at the end of C04 when the camera pans across to show Artia.[/p][/*][*][p]Complete all corrupted (Humgrump) Challenge Mode minigames (without skipping)[/p][list][*][p]Boxing[/p][/*][*][p]Volleyball[/p][/*][*][p]Potion pop[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Complete the Big Brawl at the end of C09 without dying.[/p][p][/p][/*][/list][h3]Dialogue Fast Forward[/h3][p]You can hold the X button or Space Bar to fast forward through all dialogue without repeatedly pressing for each box that pops up.[/p][p][/p][p]The dev team has set up a new form so you can directly send in bug and issue reports to them. If you are encountering problems in the game on the latest versions, please send them over here: [/p][p][/p][p][url="https://docs.google.com/forms/d/e/1FAIpQLSeZcEdKi5xrBuEZbqmRD_MH-eTl4mEps2IwDPDpA9NDuNgqrg/viewform" style="button"]The Plucky Squire Public Bug Submission Form[/url][/p][p][/p][p]Finally, to celebrate, [b]The Plucky Squire is now 35% OFF[/b] in the Steam Summer Sale — our biggest discount yet! Help us spread the word! [/p][p][/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/1627570/The_Plucky_Squire/"][/dynamiclink][/p][p]That's all for now, Squires! We hope you enjoy this new adventure![/p][p]
[/p][p][/p][p][/p]

notes.title: Version 1.15.1 adding Streamlined Mode!
notes.content:
[h2]Hello Squires! [/h2]

We’ve added a brand new mode to The Plucky Squire in today’s update. In [i][b]Streamlined Mode[/b][/i], you’ll play through Jot’s adventures at a quicker tempo! We’ve been looking at the feedback about the game, and one of the points that came up was that the pacing was a little too slow for some players. Enter: Streamlined Mode!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42507006/574632c2e69ceffd5593bbb013df893bcd88e299.png[/img]
[h2]Streamlined Mode[/h2]
Streamlined mode is intended for more experienced players who want less guidance and more action. For example! A door unlocks - do you really need the game to stop and the camera to pan over and look at it opening? Maybe not! In Streamlined Mode, it doesn’t! This is one of the many examples of reduced guidance.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42507006/8f55282bf8998c0963eba0c8d43cfa3c45bde224.jpg[/img]
We’ve cut some fat from the dialogue in Streamlined Mode - a line here, a line there... It’s not like we’ve hacked away entire scenes, just trimmed bits for a more…streamlined…experience.

We’ve also added speech bubble portraits to keep track of who’s speaking while you’re speeding through.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42507006/9c8895f728eb7156531977b18affff0bd82ad9c4.png[/img]

Finally, we've included some quality of life improvements and changes. We've increased the number of historical autosaves that are kept and we've added a function to restart the current chapter. If you do get stuck somewhere, both of these should help. Autosaves have been moved to a place in the menu that's easier to find and we've added a way to change the language in-game.

[h2]The Game Awards Nomination and Sale[/h2]

We are deeply honoured to be nominated at The Game Awards for Best Family Game and Best Debut Indie. To thank you and everyone who has supported us, we have put the game on sale for 25% off! Just in time for the Holiday Season! 

The Plucky Squire was inspired by the picture books we loved reading to our children. Our dream was always to create something that families could enjoy together. Whoever makes up your family, we hope The Plucky Squire can bring you and your loved ones some joy!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42507006/a072ba0ab89bc2f9d0f9ec1b14d493e7b789ffac.gif[/img]

[h2]Patch Notes[/h2]
Shiny and New - Streamline Mode:
[list]
[*] Shorter, snappier dialogue that lets you enjoy the story but gets you to the action quicker
[*] Fewer camera events that slow down player action
[*] Added dialogue portraits for major characters
[*] Added an in-game language change option
[*] Added More Save History slots and moved them to "Load Save" in the "Save Files" menu
[/list]
Bug fixes
[list]
[*] Fixed soft lock in credits
[*] Fixed bottom half of Alowynia card being blacked out
[*] Various fixes to collision issues
[/list]

notes.title: The Plucky Squire - Update Version 1.13.1
notes.content:
Hey everyone! We are releasing a new update with many bug fixes and improvements. Here's the patch notes from version 1.13.1. 

[list]
[*] Fixed being able to throw important food items to inaccessible areas in chapter 2.
[*] Fixed character getting stuck after interacting with the rabbit in chapter 2 if placing objects down in front of it.
[*] Fixed invisible platform in a section of chapter 2.
[*] Fixed an interaction to jump that could be triggered from too far away leading to the jump failing in chapter 4.
[*] Fixed being able to keep grabbing a block after it has transformed into something else in chapter 4.
[*] Fixed being able to progress to a further section of chapter 4 in an unintended manner early which led to other issues.
[*] Fixed the possibility to throw a key in an inaccessible area in chapter 4.
[*] Fixed a key becoming stuck in some furniture in chapter 5.
[*] Fixed character becoming stuck if jumping in a specific location in chapter 5.
[*] Fixed enemies becoming passive if not killing them when first crossing them in chapter 5.
[*] Fixed being able to go through a scary obstacle using brute force which would prevent from going back to the intended path of chapter 6.
[*] Fixed camera becoming stuck if going off the desk in chapter 6.
[*] Fixed the possibility to use the roll while pulling interactive objects in chapter 6 which lead to the character not moving as intended.
[*] Fixed becoming stuck between floors of the volcano if pressing the jump button repeatedly in chapter 7.
[*] Fixed camera becoming stuck between floors of the volcano if reloading after specific checkpoints in chapter 7.
[*] Fixed the possibility of getting stranded in an area if using an unintended solution to keep a bridge open in chapter 7.
[*] Fixed becoming stuck if using a stop stamp on a tank before getting the intended weapon to destroy it in chapter 7.
[*] Fixed being able to backtrack from a specific page in chapter 9 to prevent possible softlocks.
[*] Fixed NPCs repeating dialogue if reloading during chapter 9.
[*] Fixed the shopkeeper not appearing when using the Chapter Replay feature even when she has something to sell.
[*] Fixed developer information appearing on screen when using a specific combination of input.
[*] Fixed jarring movement on respawning after dying while grabbing an object.
[*] Fixed light bulbs colliding with objects and moving them to unintended positions.
[/list]

notes.title: See How Our Launch Trailer Was Made + First Update
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42507006/86a4f5bd21de3e9b188b16539494dc5d9038f982.png[/img]

[h1]Thank you![/h1]

After four years of work we finally launched The Plucky Squire this week.

It's quite a thing to spend so long on one project, then  release it into the world. Our goal was to give people a wonderful experience, so we are overjoyed to see your reactions!

We appreciate everyone who has followed us and our studio's first game. More than anything, we hope you're enjoying your adventures in the Land of Mojo. 

We can't say it enough. Thank you.

By now, we hope you've seen our incredible papercraft launch trailer. But how did paper engineers Julia and Yeray bring our virtual storybook world to real REAL life? Let's go behind the scenes and find out.

[previewyoutube=niS7UZJali4;full][/previewyoutube]

[h1]Update plan[/h1]

We've just released our first patch of fixes to The Plucky Squire. It contains fixes to a number of blockers and other issues. We are continuing to work on more improvements. If you ever get stuck, please try the Save History feature. It will let you access a few recent autosaves It won't solve every problem but additional updates are on the way! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42507006/f4284a10d1808416ed72b7aecc27dd3ae1904aa6.gif[/img]

[h1]Update 1.11 Patch Notes: [/h1]
[list]
[*] Fixed Fatal Error Crash in cliff descent section in Chapter 2
[*] Fixed Jot not respawning correctly when jumping off the edge of the desk near the candle in Chapter 6
[*] Fixed blockers created by stone block being placed on minecart and moved in Chapter 6

[*] Fixed NPCs not following Jot in Chapter 7 (C07_P1516)

[*] Fixed overexposed textures in desk scenes

[/list]

notes.title: The Plucky Squire launches tomorrow!
notes.content:
[h1]Release Times[/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42507006/416f726398fa1b18f65de57a9301057fc41ff5b6.png[/img]

After 4 years of development, we will be launching The Plucky Squire tomorrow, September 17 at 9AM PT. When we started this studio, we did not think we would be making a game like this, nor a game this big as our first title. Huge shoutout to all of you who have followed us and given us your support to get to this point. 

[h1]An Adventure for Everyone[/h1]

[previewyoutube=JdNZo7E_hXU;full][/previewyoutube]

We've added a variety of features to customize gameplay to your preferences. You can watch this video to see the different options:

⚔️ Adventure Mode and Story Mode
🦘 Jump assist
🍃 Disable falling platforms
🌟 Invincibility and One hit kill
🪱 Helpful hint characters
💫 Reveal hidden portals

[h1]Steam Deluxe Edition and Extras[/h1]

At launch tomorrow, you'll also be able to support us with the Ddigital Artbook, Soundtrack and Deluxe Edition. The Artbook will be $4.99, the Soundtrack will be $9.99 and all of them together as a Deluxe Edition bundle will be $39.99 - a discount over 10%. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42507006/dd232867a90b857a2fa3732ee2010e5318876640.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42507006/23e67e5e7bd781672ee4da6faaef79582877ab6b.png[/img]

[h1]System Requirements[/h1]

Finally, we updated the system requirements over the weekend. You can find them on the game's Steam store page as well. 

 [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42507006/a66d5bb52eae1ef8bc7bb177b284715d455e38c6.png[/img]

notes.content:
[previewyoutube=Ky1eS1VafzI;full][/previewyoutube]
Hey everyone,

We're very happy to show you The Plucky Squire in all 11 localizations with full audio and their voice over actors!

It was a big challenge to bring the game to each new language. In our game, words aren't just on the UI, they're gameplay objects that effect the world. We've done our best to ensure that each word puzzle makes sense in all 11 localizations, along with all the bonus possibilities when you throw unintended word combinations together.
